leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a nonce store to track used request identifiers
Construct a middleware function to validate request timestamps
Apply a nonce validation check within the request signing verification process
Configure a timestamp window to reject requests outside an acceptable time range
Integrate nonce and timestamp checks into an existing request authentication flow
Manipulate request headers to include required nonce and timestamp values
Update a route handler to reject requests that fail replay attack defenses
lessonTitle: Build replay attack defenses for signed requests
